issues.legal_issue: A preliminary land notice is invalid when it includes premises on which processes ancillary to coal production are carried on.
material_facts: The notice covered land containing a railway siding, boiler rooms, office rooms, a fan house and air-shaft premises.
Processes ancillary to getting, dressing or preparing coal for sale were being carried on in those premises.
issues.conclusion: The notice violated the second limb of section 4(4) and was invalid.
issues.legal_principle: Section 4(4) requires exclusion from a notice under section 4(1) of premises on which processes ancillary to the getting, dressing or preparation for sale of coal obtained from mining operations are carried on. No earlier case was relied on for this holding.

predicates.notification_challenge: A party challenges a preliminary notice concerning land.
predicates.notice_covers_ancillary_facilities: The notice includes land on which facilities used for ancillary coal processes are situated.
predicates.facilities_support_coal_processing: Processes ancillary to producing, dressing or preparing coal for sale are carried on in those facilities.

issues.definition: When a challenged notice covers facilities used for ancillary coal processing, the notice is invalid.

issues.legal_issue: A court may decide an issue that was not specifically pleaded when the necessary facts are on the record and the issue was fully argued without objection.
material_facts: The written petition did not specifically plead the ground based on the second limb of section 4(4).
The facts necessary to decide that ground were before the court.
The ground was fully argued in the High Court without objection.
issues.conclusion: The issue could be considered despite the absence of a specific pleading.
issues.legal_principle: In proceedings under Article 226, the court could consider the issue on the record where the necessary facts were before it and the issue had been fully argued without objection. No earlier case was relied on for this holding.

rule.if: writ_review and ground_not_specifically_pleaded and necessary_facts_on_record and ground_fully_argued_without_objection

predicates.writ_review: A court is reviewing a matter in a writ proceeding.
predicates.ground_not_specifically_pleaded: The party did not specifically plead the ground the court is asked to consider.
predicates.necessary_facts_on_record: The facts needed to decide the ground are before the court.
predicates.ground_fully_argued_without_objection: The ground was fully argued without an objection to the court considering it.

issues.definition: In writ review, a court may decide an unpleaded ground when the necessary facts are on the record and the ground was fully argued without objection.

issues.legal_issue: A short delay in bringing a writ challenge to a land notice is not by itself sufficient to refuse relief for laches.
material_facts: The challenged notice was issued about five months before the writ petition was filed.
issues.conclusion: The delay was not sufficient to refuse the requested relief.
issues.legal_principle: The Court held on the circumstances that the delay in filing the writ petition was not sufficient to refuse relief. No earlier case was relied on for this holding.

predicates.writ_challenge_to_land_notice: A party brings a writ challenge to a notice concerning land.
predicates.filing_delay_was_limited: The party filed the challenge after a limited delay from the notice.

issues.definition: When a writ challenge to a land notice is filed after only a limited delay, relief is not refused for delay alone.

issues.legal_issue: A challenge to a preliminary land notice is not premature when the notice immediately suspends the affected lease operations.
material_facts: On issuance of the preliminary notice, the mining lease ceased to have effect in the notified area while the notice remained in force.
The notice required operations in that area to stop pending further action or the end of the applicable period.
issues.conclusion: The challenger was already aggrieved by the notice, so the writ petition was not premature.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5 provides that a mining lease ceases to have effect in the notified land while the preliminary notice is in force; section 7 provides for further acquisition proceedings and the period within which they may be initiated. The immediate suspension of operations meant the affected party was aggrieved before those later proceedings.

predicates.challenge_to_preliminary_land_notice: A party challenges a preliminary notice concerning land before final acquisition proceedings.
predicates.notice_suspends_lease_operations: The notice immediately suspends the affected party's lease operations in the notified area.

issues.definition: A challenge to a preliminary land notice is not premature when the notice immediately suspends the affected lease operations.

issues.legal_issue: When a land notice is invalid because it includes protected premises, the court does not decide whether other land could have been included or create a replacement notice.
material_facts: The notice included premises that could not lawfully be notified.
The government contended that other parts of the leasehold could have been notified.
issues.conclusion: The Court would not decide whether other areas could have been notified or make a new notice for the government.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 4(1), read with the exclusions in section 4(4), the Court would not determine whether other areas could have been notified once the impugned notice was invalid, and it could not make out a new notice for the government. No earlier case was relied on for this holding.

predicates.challenge_to_land_notice: A party challenges a notice concerning land.
predicates.notice_includes_excluded_premises: The notice includes premises that the governing rule requires to be excluded.
predicates.notice_is_invalid: The challenged notice is invalid because it includes those premises.

issues.definition: When a challenged land notice is invalid because it includes excluded premises, the court does not reconstruct it by determining or substituting other areas.
